programme.desc: S7 E7 — Dessert Week Three sweet challenges will mean a bitter end for one of the six remaining bakers as they battle for a place in the quarter-final. For starters, the bakers face a sweetly filled signature challenge that has them rolling out their skills to impress Mary and Paul. And, if that wasn't enough, the technical challenge is one of the toughest of the series so far, which layers on the sweet pressure, as we test the bakers on a tricky French dessert.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S7 E9 — Patisserie Week It is the Bake Off semi-final, and it is pâtisserie week, with just four bakers remaining. In the signature challenge, the bakers are once again butter bashing and folding their pastry to achieve perfect lamination for a difficult French pastry.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S7 E10 — The Final It is the final with just three bakers remaining, and the theme is a Royal Bake Off. The last signature challenge sees a return to meringues, a challenge that a few of the bakers stumbled over in week six.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S8 E1 — Cake Week For the first challenge, the bakers were instructed to make a cake using fresh fruit. For the technical challenge, the bakers were instructed to make 12 chocolate mini rolls. The showstopper challenge required the bakers to make an illusion cake.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S8 E2 — Biscuit Week For the signature challenge, the bakers are instructed to make 24 sandwich biscuits. The technical challenge requires the bakers to make fortune cookies. In the final showstopper challenge, the bakers are required to make a biscuit board game.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S2 E10 — Bacon Me Crazy Adam travels to Johannesburg, South Africa, to sample the city's off-menu eats, including a bacon-wrapped sandwich stuffed with cheese, succulent braised lamb shank, a Mediterranean kofta wrap, and a chocolate doughnut sundae.
programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Clock and Dagger Adam travels to Cape Town to seek out the city's best off-menu dishes, including South African sausage, freshly caught fish and chips, a springbok loin served in an old Victorian house and a secret, invite-only restaurant.
programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman

programme.desc: S2 E14 — Diva-Licious Pig Roast Adam travels to Manila for the city's best off-menu dishes, including ostrich salpicao, New York strip at a secret steakhouse, soupless ramen and a 12-course lechon dinner at a restaurant hidden inside a chef's home.
programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Cashew 'Cue Adam's hunting for secret restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, like a hidden pho bar, off-menu cashew smoked ribs and grilled pork wrapped in lemon grass at a hidden garden restaurant in the city.

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Electric Guitars Gibson Guitars reveal how high-tech machinery, handcrafting skills and global logistics combine to bring their electric guitars to the world's stage.

programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Big Apple A look at how some popular foods are made in food factories, including spanakopita, ginger snaps, tartufo and apple juice.
programme.title: Food Factory

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Keeper Tales

programme.desc: S1 E10 — Downward Facing Elephant At Columbus Zoo, a huge team is tasked with capturing an escaped alligator. Elsewhere, elephant Hank practices his yoga postures, and at the safari park, the team races to cool down an African wild dog suffering from excess heat.
programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Keeper Tales

programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S5 E9 — Ramses: Master of War Archaeologists investigate the battle strategies of Ramses the Second, Egypt's warrior pharaoh.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E95 — Sasha & Essence Sasha is in a wild flirtationship with Essence and is ready for the next level; Essence says she's in an open relationship with her man, but Sasha feels like she is keeping a secret.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E87 — Matt & Elise Matt's smitten with TikToker Elise, but Nev and guest host Devyn Simone see red flags on the horizon; when asked to meet, Elise says she's worried about upsetting Nev.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S08 E88 — Moses & Krystal After a tough divorce, Moses finds new hope in Krystal, but despite living close by, Krystal won't meet up.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S03 E13 — Scareder Than a Mug Helen (Ellia English) ends up in therapy after an encounter with a mugger.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Forever Your Girl Jamie (Jamie Foxx) jumps to the service of a beautiful hotel guest (guest star Angelle Brooks); Junior and Helen (Garrett Morris, Ellia English) buy a karaoke player.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Where There's a Will, Go the Other Way Braxton and Fancy (Christopher B. Duncan, Garcelle Beauvais) get raises, leaving Jamie (Jamie Foxx) feeling slighted.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S05 E08 — The High Life Shawn (Shawn Wayans) suspects Marlon's (Marlon Wayans) new movie-star friend is having a bad influence on his brother.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S05 E11 — A Country Christmas Pops and the boys learn the real meaning of Christmas when they visit rural relatives living in poverty.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S28 E04 — Skate Park, Siblings, and Daddy Daughter Time A birthday girl wishes for a better cake; teen sisters interrupt piano practice with their funny dance interpretation; mishaps between dads and their daughters; a daughter helps wax her dad's stomach.
programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.desc: S28 E05 — A Bit of Bad Luck, Mind Blowing Magic, and Not So Macho A man's tire rolls and knocks down a neighbor's mailbox; a car sunroof that leaks during a drive-through car wash; kids amazed by magic tricks; a macho guy encounters bats.
programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.desc: S28 E06 — Summer Fun, On the Job, and Literal Kids A delivery man forgets to put the brakes on his truck; a chicken surprises a woman; a raccoon tries to pass for a household pet; a person only paying attention to their phone has an encounter with a full table of food.
programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Best Party Planner Ever A tropical storm rages; Snooki and Angelina reenact their famous fight; and the roomies party on a boat that's also a mansion.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E11 — The Sexpert The Florida Keys get emotional when a sex therapist digs deep into Angelina and Chris' relationship; then they get messy when the meatballs create an impromptu late-night talk show; and even messier when Mike finds a note from Pauly D.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E12 — The Lie Detector Test On the last day, the roomies take on a lie detector test; someone takes gold on Wide World of Guidos; Snooki searches for her wine.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E13 — Livin' La Vida Loca Mike learns that blondes have more fun; Pauly takes over Madison Square Garden; and the group chat is lit when pictures surface of Angelina in Mexico with a man who's not her husband.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E14 — Spill the Tea Angelina tells her side of the story; Jenni and Nicole bribe Deena to spill the tea; Pauly plans a good, old-fashioned OG vacation; Mike and Lauren have a difficult decision to make about Mosey.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E15 — Old Mike vs. New Mike The road to El Paso takes an unexpected turn when a bunch of rumors and allegations are given to Mike; and he sends them straight to group chat, where all hell breaks loose.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.
programme.title: A Clockwork Orange

programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.
programme.title: Basic Instinct

programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.
programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad

programme.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.
programme.title: Logan's Run

programme.desc: William Popper (Michael Sarrazin) is a wealthy, shiftless college student at Columbia who, one night in a rainstorm, accidentally kills a jaywalker with his car. Sentenced to a year in prison for manslaughter, William begins serving his term, but before it's finished he decides to break out. With the help of his faithful and politically radical girlfriend, Jane (Barbara Hershey), he skips town and escapes to Canada, where the two are obliged to live like fugitives.
programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness

programme.desc: A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal "Rooster" Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.
programme.title: True Grit

programme.desc: A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.
programme.title: Shenandoah

programme.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves

programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.
programme.title: Lake Placid

programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.
programme.title: Anaconda

programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.
programme.title: Jaws

programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.
programme.title: Jaws 2

programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.
programme.title: Jaws III

programme.desc: Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive.
programme.title: Goodfellas

programme.desc: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fuelled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
programme.title: Scarface

When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.
programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.
programme.title: Hook

programme.desc: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.
programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.
programme.title: Addams Family Values

programme.desc: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.
programme.title: Small Soldiers

programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.
programme.title: The Borrowers

programme.title: Babe
